newsitem.title: UK: Air France sees few UK flights due Thursday strike.
newsitem.headline: Air France sees few UK flights due Thursday strike.

text.p: Air France in London said that due to a planned French civil service strike on Thursday, it was planning big cuts to its Thursday flight schedules between France and Britain.
The strike means the carrier will have to cut its intra-European flights to a minimum tomorrow.

"Flights between the United Kingdom and France will be severely curtailed. There will only be three services scheduled from London Heathrow to Charles de Gaulle (Paris) to connect with Air France long-haul flights," the company said here.
Only two other lines will be kept going, from Heathrow to Strasbourg and from Southampton to Charles de Gaulle.
It added it would cancel all its other services from the UK provinces and London City airport.
Air France said customers booked on flights cancelled due to the strike were being contacted and given the choice of a later flight or a total refund.

Although some rebooking with other airlines would be possible, Air France noted that the French civil aviation authority had asked all airlines operating to and from France to drastically reduce their services during the 24-hour strike.
